quests.title: Ore survey
quests.text: The scintillometer finds uranium ore; the survey tool and blueprints lay out big plants. Mine the ores the plants below need.

quests.title: Sulfuric acid
quests.text: Burn sulfur from salt-dome caprock in the acid plant: melter, furnace, waste heat boiler, converter and absorbers. Its steam can run a turbine.

quests.title: Frasch sulfur
quests.text: Drill into a salt dome's caprock with the land rig (the small rig cannot stop there) and set a Frasch wellhead: 165 C water from a Frasch water heater, lift air from a compressor, and a bleed water well into the same caprock. Molten sulfur goes straight to the acid plant's furnace or to a vat.

quests.title: Chlor-alkali and DC
quests.text: Brine through a membrane cell room on a rectifier transformer makes chlorine, caustic and hydrogen. DC bus bar carries the cell current.

quests.title: Coke ovens
quests.text: A coke oven battery bakes coal into metallurgical coke; its gas can fuel a gas genset.

quests.title: Ammonia
quests.text: Hydrogen from a steam reformer and nitrogen from the air meet in the ammonia converter. Store it in a pressure bullet.

quests.title: Fertilizer bags
quests.text: Phosphate rock and sulfuric acid make phosphoric acid; with ammonia, the granulation plant fills bags of DAP.

quests.title: Aluminium
quests.text: Bauxite to alumina in the Bayer refinery, then pots on a rectiformer smelt it. A pot is built on calcined coke: crude-unit residue through the delayed coker (heater, coke drum, fractionator) and the coke kiln. Its later anodes take coke-oven pitch.

quests.title: Zirconium
quests.text: Zircon chlorinated, hafnium taken out, reduced in a Kroll reactor and drawn into Zircaloy cladding tube.

quests.title: Helium
quests.text: Helium from the gas fill rides in steel cylinders: fuel rods are welded and filled under it.

quests.title: Boron
quests.text: Borax to boric acid for the reactor's coolant, and boron carbide pellets for its control rods.
